open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intros Hnorm
  induction post <;>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, extractOldExprVars,
          Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at * <;>
    try simp_all
  case app fn e fn_ih e_ih =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    . simp [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
      intros x Hin
      omega
    . next Hfalse =>
      cases Hnorm with
      | app H1 H2 Hn =>
      exfalso
      specialize Hn ?_
      constructor
      cases Hn
      apply Hfalse
      rfl
    . cases Hnorm with
      | app H1 H2 Hn =>
      apply List.Subset.app
      . apply List.Subset.trans fn_ih H1
        intros x Hin
        exact List.mem_append_left (Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars e) Hin
      . apply List.Subset.trans e_ih H2
        intros x Hin
        exact List.mem_append_right (Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars fn) Hin
  case abs ih =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply ih <;> assumption
  case quant trih eih =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans trih ‹_› ‹_›
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
    . apply List.Subset.trans eih ‹_› ‹_›
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
  case ite cih tih eih =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans cih ‹_› ‹_›
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans tih ‹_› ‹_›
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
    . apply List.Subset.trans eih ‹_› ‹_›
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
  case eq ih1 ih2 =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans ih1 ‹_› ‹_›
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
    . apply List.Subset.trans ih2 ‹_› ‹_›
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
